title: REDUCE allows its accumulator to hold a multi-cell array whereas SCAN rejects multi-cell LAMBDA results with #CALC!
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, REDUCE permits its LAMBDA accumulator to hold and return a multi-cell array (e.g. TEXTSPLIT), whereas SCAN rejects any multi-cell LAMBDA result with #CALC!. For both helpers, a reference source argument passes one-cell references into the LAMBDA while an array literal passes values, and any non-LAMBDA final argument (even an error or number) returns #VALUE!.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 across fn2_questions (fn2_q091, fn2_q092), jnt_aggregate_arrays (rows 104-105), and f3_arrays (rows 35-37).
